content.title: Weekly research intake — 2026-11-27 — enrolled, returning, high-school and military students
content.body:
<!-- degreesteps-research-intake:v1 -->

## Real student scenarios and product acceptance cases
These anonymized cases were supplied by the owner. Verify primary policy and improve the existing guided experience and substantive content; do not invent receiving awards or promote an unmapped template. Keep historical policies, current degree identity, student records and benefits eligibility separate.

## Currently enrolled
- [ ] Evaluate a business MyPath student enrolled at UMass Global in 2024: distinguish already-earned unsubmitted credit from new outside coursework while enrolled; verify the admission-cohort requirements, residency, minimum grades, credit-hour-to-competency evaluation and permission before any purchase. Explain why MyPath is missing from complete plans and build only source-supported requirements/mappings. https://catalog.umassglobal.edu/pdf/University%20of%20Massachusetts%20Global%202024-2025%20Catalog.pdf https://umassglobal.sophia.org/

## Returning to college
- [ ] Evaluate roughly two years of regionally accredited on-campus credit earned about 25 years ago for a business degree. Preserve original courses/grades/units/dates, compare school- and course-specific currency rules without assuming 60 applicable credits or starting from zero, and improve upload-first guidance and the existing older-credit article. https://tesu.smartcatalogiq.com/en/current/undergraduate-catalog/university-policies-and-procedures/undergraduate-academic-policies/degree-policies/degree-requirements/ https://www.umassglobal.edu/admissions/admissions-faqs

## High school
- [ ] Productize college-credit head starts and actual dual enrollment separately: issuing-college transcripts, provider age/consent and ID rules, school approval, state-specific funding and first-year classification. Add a useful sourced guide and high-school starting context without treating a high-school report card as college credit. https://ulc.asu.edu/help-center/faqs/ https://www.fldoe.org/schools/higher-ed/fl-college-system/dual-enroll-transfer/

## Military learners
- [ ] Improve military and family guidance: JST/CCAF records, eligibility-specific tuition rates and mandatory fees, DANTES-funded first attempts, and separate funding decisions. Do not assume every veteran/dependent receives active-duty tuition or automatically apply discounts to estimates. Replace closed sources and add a benefits task through the existing flow. https://www.va.gov/resources/how-do-i-get-college-credits-for-my-military-service/ https://clep.collegeboard.org/clep-military-benefits

Implement only verified details, retain native provenance and scoped dates, use the existing state/checklist/content architecture, run preservation and desktop/mobile tests, open a PR, and publish only through the established verified release process. Current-student ambiguity must produce a practical approval step rather than a blanket acceptance promise or dead end.
